remarks: Welcome to this exquisite 2016-built colonial in the heart of the coveted Springdale neighborhood, offering an incredible blend of luxury and comfort. Nestled on a beautifully landscaped flat acre, this home boasts 6 spacious bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and a grand double-story foyer that invites you in. Cozy up by any of the three fireplaces or retreat to the finished basement with a temperature-controlled wine cellar and infrared sauna for ultimate relaxation. The gourmet kitchen features high-end appliances, soft-close cabinets, and stunning quartz countertops, perfect for any home chef. A first-floor home office provides the ideal workspace, while the backyard is an entertainer's dream, featuring an outdoor kitchen and pizza oven. Fully paid-off Tesla solar panels mean zero electric bills, and there's even an electric car charging station. With public water and sewer, and located near Sterling Farms Golf Course and the Italian Center, this home offers the perfect mix of elegance, comfort, and convenience.
